search_text: published ZDI-21-090 ZDI-CAN-12671 (0Day) Microsoft Windows win32kfull bRotate NULL Pointer Dereference Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2021-01-27 7.8 AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Microsoft'] ['Windows'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the win32kfull.sys driver. The issue results from dereferencing a NULL pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
